key_insight: As AI makes publication-based signals of understanding less reliable, academic hiring becomes a strategic dilemma between deep expertise, publication volume, and interview-based assessment.
engineering_relevance: The framework can inform hiring practices in computational science and engineering that distinguish genuine understanding from AI-assisted research output.
method: Model applicant effort and recruiter hiring criteria as a two-sided game.
Classify all pure-strategy equilibria within the model.
Simulate learning to explore behaviors applicant and recruiter populations may adopt.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical equilibrium analysis and learning simulations, but provides no empirical hiring data or quantitative results.
watch_item: Practical use depends on whether interviews reliably assess deep understanding, which the abstract does not establish.
paper_title: Game theory of academic effort and hiring in the age of AI
